basic_info.description: Welcome to 69 Lisbon Street, a blank canvas nestled in the vibrant heart of San Francisco. This is a unique opportunity for those with a vision to bring this property back to life. Spanning 1,300 square feet, this home offers a flexible layout that caters to both creative living arrangements and investment opportunities.  Step into the full garage providing ample space for storage, a workshop, and an existing bonus space. The property sits on a generous 2,500 square foot lot, offering room to expand or create a stunning outdoor oasis.  Located in the convenient Excelsior District, this property ensures you're never far from the action. With easy access to Hwy 101 and Hwy 280, convenience is at your doorstep. Whether you're looking to transform this space into your dream home or seeking an investment with substantial potential, 69 Lisbon Street is the perfect place to start.  Sold as-is, this property invites you to unlock its full potential and create something truly special. Don't miss out on this excellent opportunity to make your mark in one of San Francisco's thriving neighborhoods
